# axm docs publish

Publish a docs package

## When to use

Publish a docs package

## Usage

```bash
axm docs publish [flags] <input>
```

## Arguments

| Name    | Type   | Required | Description                         |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `input` | string | Yes      | docs package FQN (@owner/docs/name) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                         |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--registry`    | string  | No       | Registry source name to publish to                                                  |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Publish from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Publish without confirmation                                                        |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Bypass conflict warnings where supported; published versions remain immutable       |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would publish without uploading                                           |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Publish a docs package**

```bash
axm docs publish @acme/docs/workspace-baseline
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
